description: Several small toys lie on the blue bedspread, including a green block, a blue tray, a tiny white-and-pink cup, a yellow piece, and a light green bowl to the right. The right hand moves in from the right, reaches down to grasp the small cup as a right-hand object, lifts it up and carries it rightward, then lowers it into the green bowl and releases it so the cup rests inside while the hand withdraws.
